result.instructions: smart-mesh meshing session. Tools named `<namespace>__<op>` apply ops (for example `model__create_brick`); query tools read the current state. Entity ids are `Kind#serial` strings (for example `TopoVolume#1`); take them from `delta.outputs` of earlier results. `run_script` runs command-language text, `session_hash` gives a reproducibility hash, `help` lists and describes tools.

tools.description: Several ops applied atomically as one node; later ops may reference ids allocated by earlier ones (`$i.role`).

BatchEntityId.description: Entity id `Kind#serial`, a batch reference `$i.role` / `$i.role[k]` / `$i.role[*]` (`[*]` only as an array element), or a `$$`-escaped literal

Makes a brick (the mock never applies it).
Op `model.create_brick` (payload version 1). The result holds `node`, `state` and `delta`.

- volume (TopoVolume, one): the brick volume
- faces (TopoFace, many): the six faces

tools.description: Run smart-mesh command-language text against the session. Commands apply ops in order and a failure stops the script. The result holds the final state hash, the printed output, one event per command and the diagnostics.

path.description: Script path, for diagnostics and relative includes.

tools.name: run_script
tools.title: Run script

tools.description: Export a mesh to a file and/or inline as base64. A relative `path` resolves against the project root, else the server's working directory. `format` is inferred from the extension. Without `mesh` the only mesh is exported; no mesh or several meshes is an error.

inline.description: Return the bytes base64-encoded in the result.

mesh.description: Mesh id; optional when the state holds exactly one mesh.

path.description: Output file; omit for inline-only output.

tools.name: session_export
tools.title: Export mesh

tools.description: Quantized hash of the whole state at `at` (the current state when absent), plus one digest per layer. Equal hashes mean equal states.

at.description: Revision to hash. A branch name, a 64-hex node hash, or "empty" (the state before any op). To name a branch literally called `empty`, or one whose name is 64 lowercase hex characters, use {"ref": name}; a node can also be given as {"node": hash}.

tools.name: session_hash
tools.title: State hash

tools.description: Where the session stands: HEAD, current node, depth, state hash, branches, redo depth and whether anything is unsaved.
tools.name: session_status
tools.title: Session status

tools.description: Create a branch (at `at`, else the current node) and attach HEAD to it.

at.description: Node to branch at; the current node when absent.

tools.name: timeline_branch
tools.title: Create branch

tools.description: Move HEAD to a revision: a branch name, a node hash, or `empty`.

rev.description: Target revision. A branch name, a 64-hex node hash, or "empty" (the state before any op). To name a branch literally called `empty`, or one whose name is 64 lowercase hex characters, use {"ref": name}; a node can also be given as {"node": hash}.
